title: Work for a binary power construction
statement: For coefficient-vector length $\ell$ and exponent bound $e$, define the work to be $\ell$ plus the traversal work for the list of indices $0,\ldots,e-1$, with step cost equal to one more than the work of a modular multiplication at length $\ell$.
caveat: The formal statement refers to traversal and modular-multiplication work definitions that are not included in this payload, so their precise meanings cannot be independently rendered.
